# IntAbs Interrupt-Driven Benchmarks

Source: https://github.com/ChunghaSung/intAbs

This directory is reserved for the IntAbs benchmark artifact. The paper reports
35 interrupt-driven applications and 22,541 LOC. Record the exact commit or
archive URL, license, and import date when adding files.

Do not edit imported source files in place. Normalize `__VERIFIER_*` helpers in
separate harness/support files.
